summary_1line: Dhaumya explains the sacred cosmic geography around Mount Meru and the realms of gods, Yama, Varuna, Brahma, and Narayana to Yudhishthira.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Dhaumya stands with Yudhishthira at sunrise pointing across the horizon while the golden peak of Mount Meru glows in the distance.
A radiant Mount Meru rises at the center of the world with Brahma seated above and the luminous realm of Narayana blazing beyond the sun’s light.
The celestial court of Brahma sits upon Meru’s summit surrounded by sages and shining gods under a vast cosmic sky.
